units.text: Penicillin was discovered in 1928 by the Scottish physician Alexander Fleming as a crude extract of P. rubens . [ 6 ] Fleming's student Cecil George Paine was the first to successfully use penicillin to treat eye infection ( neonatal conjunctivitis ) in 1930. Penicillins ( P , PCN or PEN ) are a group of β-lactam antibiotics originally obtained from Penicillium moulds , principally P. chrysogenum and P. rubens . Eight species of Penicillium , in the section Chrysogena, produce penicillins. In the United States, 10% of the population claims penicillin allergies , but because the frequency of positive skin test results decreases by 10% with each year of avoidance, 90% of these patients can eventually tolerate penicillin. Additionally, those with penicillin allergies can usually tolerate cephalosporins (another group of β-lactam) because the immunoglobulin E (IgE) cross-reactivity is only 3%. [ 5 ]
Several semisynthetic penicillins are effective against a broader spectrum of bacteria: these include the antistaphylococcal penicillins , aminopenicillins , and antipseudomonal penicillins .
